labels.desc: Containing the labels of the regions. The length of the label array corresponds to the number of dimensions requested. ``data.labels[i]`` is the label corresponding to volume ``i`` in the 'maps' image.

maps.desc: Path to 4D nifti file containing regions definition. The shape of the image is ``(104, 123, 104, dimension)`` where ``dimension`` is the requested dimension of the atlas.
